orderAddressPolicy: shared-inventory-wallet; bind exact submitted transaction hash and event index to order
notice: Operator template for the one-way Ethereum USDT deposit to SOBYA payout route. Real orders remain fail-closed until Ethereum HTTPS read-only RPC, finalized USDT watcher, verified SOBYA payout balance and gas, encrypted SOBYA payout keystore, independently verified reference liquidity, and the public HTTPS gateway are configured. Ethereum signing keys are not required. Only Ethereum USDT deposits and SOBYA EVM payouts are supported. Do not commit secrets. Price uses completed finalized ledger orders. Fees 100 bps; maximum order 500 USDT; daily cap 10,000 USDT; protected SOBY reserve 100,000.

api.notice: API enabled by default but bound to loopback only. Expose it only through an operator-managed HTTPS reverse proxy with origin allowlisting, rate limits, request-size limits, and durable storage. API enablement does not enable deposits or payouts.
